an11.14:1.1: And then Venerable Subhūti together with the meditator Saddha went up to the Buddha, bowed, and sat down to one side. The Buddha said to him,
an11.14:1.2: “Subhūti, what is the name of this meditator?”
an11.14:1.3: “Sir, the name of this meditator is Saddha. He is the son of the layman Sudatta, and has gone forth out of faith from the lay life to homelessness.”
an11.14:2.1: “Well, I hope this meditator Saddha exhibits the various evidences of faith.”
an11.14:2.2: “Now is the time, Blessed One! Now is the time, Holy One!
an11.14:2.3: Let the Buddha to speak on the evidence of faith.
an11.14:2.4: Now I will find out whether or not this meditator Saddha exhibits the various evidences of faith.”
an11.14:3.1: “Well then, Subhūti, listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”
an11.14:4.1: “Firstly, a meditator is ethical, restrained in the monastic code, conducting themselves well and resorting for alms in suitable places. Seeing danger in the slightest fault, they keep the rules they’ve undertaken.
an11.14:4.2: When a meditator is ethical, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:5.1: Furthermore, a meditator is very learned, remembering and keeping what they’ve learned. These teachings are good in the beginning, good in the middle, and good in the end, meaningful and well-phrased, describing a spiritual practice that’s entirely full and pure. They are very learned in such teachings, remembering them, rehearsing them, mentally scrutinizing them, and penetrating them theoretically.
an11.14:5.2: When a meditator is learned, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:6.1: Furthermore, a meditator has good friends, companions, and associates.
an11.14:6.2: When a meditator has good friends, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:7.1: Furthermore, a meditator is easy to admonish, having qualities that make them easy to admonish. They’re patient, and take instruction respectfully.
an11.14:7.2: When a meditator is easy to admonish, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:8.1: Furthermore, a meditator is deft and tireless in a diverse spectrum of duties for their spiritual companions, understanding how to go about things in order to complete and organize the work.
an11.14:8.2: When a meditator is deft and tireless in a diverse spectrum of duties, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:9.1: Furthermore, a meditator loves the teachings and is a delight to converse with, being full of joy in the teaching and training.
an11.14:9.2: When a meditator loves the teachings, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:10.1: Furthermore, a meditator lives with energy roused up for giving up unskillful qualities and embracing skillful qualities. They are strong, staunchly vigorous, not slacking off when it comes to developing skillful qualities.
an11.14:10.2: When a meditator is energetic, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:11.1: Furthermore, a meditator gets the four stages of meditation—blissful meditations in this life that belong to the higher mind—when they want, without trouble or difficulty.
an11.14:11.2: When a meditator gets the four stages of meditation, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:12.1: Furthermore, a meditator recollects many kinds of past lives.
an11.14:12.2: That is: one, two, three, four, five, ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, a hundred, a thousand, a hundred thousand rebirths; many eons of the world contracting, many eons of the world expanding, many eons of the world contracting and expanding. They remember: ‘There, I was named this, my clan was that, I looked like this, and that was my food. This was how I felt pleasure and pain, and that was how my life ended. When I passed away from that place I was reborn somewhere else. There, too, I was named this, my clan was that, I looked like this, and that was my food. This was how I felt pleasure and pain, and that was how my life ended. When I passed away from that place I was reborn here.’ And so they recollect their many kinds of past lives, with features and details.
an11.14:12.3: When a meditator recollects many kinds of past lives, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:13.1: Furthermore, with clairvoyance that is purified and superhuman, a meditator sees sentient beings passing away and being reborn—inferior and superior, beautiful and ugly, in a good place or a bad place. They understand how sentient beings pass on according to their deeds. ‘These dear beings did bad things by way of body, speech, and mind. They denounced the noble ones; they had wrong view; and they chose to act out of that wrong view. When their body breaks up, after death, they’re reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell. These dear beings, however, did good things by way of body, speech, and mind. They never denounced the noble ones; they had right view; and they chose to act out of that right view. When their body breaks up, after death, they’re reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.’ And so, with clairvoyance that is purified and superhuman, they see sentient beings passing away and being reborn—inferior and superior, beautiful and ugly, in a good place or a bad place. They understand how sentient beings pass on according to their deeds.
an11.14:13.2: When a meditator has clairvoyance that is purified and superhuman, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:14.1: Furthermore, a meditator has realized the undefiled freedom of heart and freedom by wisdom in this very life, and lives having realized it with their own insight due to the destruction of defilements.
an11.14:14.2: When a meditator has ended the defilements, this is evidence of faith.”
an11.14:15.1: When he said this, Venerable Subhūti said to the Buddha:
an11.14:15.2: “Sir, the various evidences of faith for a faithful person that the Buddha speaks of are found in this meditator; he does exhibit them.
an11.14:19.1: This meditator is easy to admonish …
an11.14:20.1: This meditator is deft and tireless in a diverse spectrum of duties …
an11.14:23.1: This meditator gets the four stages of meditation …
an11.14:24.1: This meditator recollects their many kinds of past lives …
an11.14:25.1: This meditator has clairvoyance that is purified and surpasses the human …
an11.14:26.1: This meditator has ended the defilements …
an11.14:26.2: The various evidences of faith for a faithful person that the Buddha speaks of are found in this meditator; he does exhibit them.”
an11.14:27.2: So, Subhūti, you should live together with this meditator Saddha.
an11.14:27.3: And when you want to see the Realized One, you should come together with him.”
